name: RoomBase
description: Send 10–15 smartphone photos of a flat (no site visit). They return an isometric 3D floor plan in 48–72h as PNG/PDF/JPG for Airbnb, Booking or your own site, with one free revision and commercial rights included. They use "AI + expert manual retouching" (company-stated). Homepage claims "+40% clicks" and "+16% bookings" from customer feedback (company-stated). The first flat is free for conciergeries (company-stated). Pricing on TrustMRR: individuals from $149, property managers from $119/property, high volume custom (founder-stated). Founded Dec 2025.

mentions.evidence: MRR $0 (per-plan purchases) · 0 subscriptions Last 30 days $2,395 · last 3 months $5,152 · last 6 months $8,430 · all-time $10,501 Monthly: $219 (Feb 2026) → $872 (Mar) → $980 (Apr) → $3,222 (May) → $56 (Jun) → $2,757 (Jul) → $80 (Sep) → $2,315 (Oct MTD). Lumpy, conciergerie-batch shaped (my read). Revenue synced 21 October 2026 ~07:35 Warsaw.
mentions.indieAngle: Sell the same thing to Polish property managers in Kraków, Gdańsk and Zakopane, and to developers' sales offices (deweloperzy) who need rzuty for listings on Otodom. Sell per-property packs of 20, not one-offs.

whyItPrints: Short-term-rental managers compete on listing photos and will pay a fixed fee per property for anything that lifts bookings. It's a per-unit B2B service sold to conciergeries that manage dozens of flats.
